justification.dataset: 000128 MC_Maze (Jenkins, M1/PMd center-out reaching) is the canonical known-good dataset for reach direction and velocity tuning.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile, trials/units/1kHz kinematics aligned correctly, reach direction computed thoughtfully from movement onset to peak speed on curated sorted units.
justification.analysis: Standard and correct: cosine fit with 1000-shuffle permutation null, two-fold cross-validated population-vector decoding, lagged velocity regression, Fisher-Lee circular correlation, and train/test Poisson GLMs.
justification.correctness: All reported values (170/182, 27.9deg error, 40.7% sector accuracy, +75ms lag, circular r=0.61, GLM 0.008->0.015) reproduce from the committed run log, are internally consistent, and rest on adequate sample sizes.
justification.figures: Figures are well-labeled with units and sample sizes, clearly show cosine tuning, decoding along the diagonal, lead-time lag, PD agreement, and GLM improvement, with example units honestly labeled as best-tuned.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and low absolute R2 values are reported plainly, but the write-up gives no dedicated limitations section (single session, modest velocity/GLM R2), a minor fault on an otherwise clean result.
justification.verdict: A comprehensive, reproducible, correctly-controlled demonstration that I would accept from a rotation student and build on.
